title: Mask Adoption Dynamics under Policy and Social Influence
description: Simulate how mask-wearing is adopted in a population during an infectious disease outbreak, capturing social influence, policy interventions, supply constraints, and their effects on disease transmission and compliance.

entities.name: Location
attributes: type (household, workplace, school, transit, retail, community)

interactions.name: contact_transmission
interactions.description: When two persons interact at a location or via a network contact, infection may transmit based on disease parameters and mask use reducing probabilities.

interactions.name: social_influence_on_adoption
interactions.description: A person's decision to adopt or continue masking is influenced by the observed mask use of their contacts and perceived social norms.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations and policy makers enforce mandates, issuing warnings or penalties to non-compliant individuals, affecting future compliance.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Media outlets and policy makers broadcast messages that update individuals’ risk perception, trust, and compliance.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to inventory, price, and demand; stockouts reduce adoption.

interactions.name: mobility_and_presence
interactions.description: Individuals move among locations according to routines, affecting contact opportunities and policy exposure.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing any mask at each timestep.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed mask adoption rate during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold_adoption
metrics.description: Days until mask adoption first reaches a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: compliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals complying with mask mandates during periods when mandates are active.

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Rt
metrics.description: Estimated reproduction number over time accounting for masking and behavior.

metrics.name: cumulative_infections
metrics.description: Total number of infection cases over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: attack_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of the population infected at least once.

metrics.name: peak_prevalence
metrics.description: Maximum fraction of the population concurrently infectious.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_index
metrics.description: Difference or ratio in adoption rates between demographic groups.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of warnings or penalties issued for non-compliance.

metrics.name: mask_stockout_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of days retailers have zero inventory for at least one mask type.

metrics.name: costs_total
metrics.description: Aggregate economic cost including mask purchases, penalties, and campaign/enforcement costs.
